implementation_notes: This document describes a whistleblower reporting tool launched by the EU AI Office. It is not itself a binding regulation but operationalizes enforcement of the AI Act. Legal protections for whistleblowers under the Whistleblower Directive apply to AI Act infringements only from 2 August 2026; until then, confidentiality is the primary protection. The tool covers general-purpose AI model providers specifically.
